standard-dialogue-interacting-with-the-g.text: If the Great Guardian is resting:

steps.text: The Great Guardian seems to be resting. You should probably not disturb it.

standard-dialogue-interacting-with-the-g.text: If the Great Guardian's power is not at 100%:

steps.npc: My power level is too low. Bring me guardian stones.

standard-dialogue-interacting-with-the-g.text: If the Great Guardian's power is at 100%:

steps.npc: Thanks, adventurer. I am now fully powered up.

standard-dialogue-entering-a-portal-guar.npc: Human, I need the power of the guardian stones.

standard-dialogue-entering-a-portal-guar.text: If the player has elemental guardian stones in their inventory

steps.text: You should feed the guardian stones to the Great Guardian before making more of them.

standard-dialogue-entering-a-portal-guar.text: If the player has catalytic guardian stones in their inventory

steps.text: You should feed the guardian stones to the Great Guardian before making more of them.

standard-dialogue-entering-a-portal-guar.text: If the player only has polyelemental guardian stones in their inventory

steps.text: You should feed the guardian stones to the Great Guardian before making more of them.

overhead-dialogue-after-reaching-full-po.npc: Humans, I now have the power to close the rift. Thank you, brave ones.
Now, for the final blow. Let the Scar be no more!

overhead-dialogue-after-reaching-full-po.text: The Great Guardian closes the rift.

overhead-dialogue-after-reaching-full-po.npc: Now, I shall rest until it opens once more...
